question: Which of the following revolutionary societies was organized by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Abhinav Bharat Society__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Society **was organized by **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar **in the Year 1904.
 
• The Abhinav Bharat Society believed in the armed revolution. 
 
• The original organization believed in armed revolution.
 
• This Organization was responsible for the assassinations of some officers of the ruling British government before being disbanded in 1952.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Some Other Societies which was founded by the Freedom Fighters of India:**

 
 
• ​Hindu Mahasabha: Madan Mohan Malviya.
 
• Home Rule League: Annie Besant and Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
 
• East India Assosciation: Dada Bhai Nauroji.
 
• Arya Samaj: Swami Dayanand Sarawati.
 
• Azad Hind Sarkar: Subhash Cahndra Bose.
